##### Project general facts

Sama Yas by Aldar is a luxury residential community set within a lush park full of flowers, birds and trees, designed to elevate comfort, style and elegance. Its low-rise buildings rise from a ground floor to seven residential floors, with architecture led by Julian Cross of Woods Bagot and interiors shaped by Mustard and Linen. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, duplexes and garden apartments, with a signature restaurant and kitchen curated by acclaimed chef Izu Ani.

Services and amenities bring a five-star hospitality experience to everyday life. Residents enjoy The Canopy Club residents' lounge, the Maison Mocha coffee shop, the private Curzon Lounge cinema, a reading room library and the Serenity Suite spa. A club gym, an infinity pool, a looping exercise track through the park and a playroom support an active family routine, while catered picnics in the park add a relaxed social touch to life in the community.

Interiors combine refined finishes with thoughtful layouts that bring in natural light and views of the surrounding greenery. Living areas open onto balconies and terraces, and garden apartments add private outdoor space. A round-the-clock concierge, room service, an exclusive house car with chauffeur, a pet concierge and dog walkers deliver effortless living, while covered parking and electric vehicle charging add convenience. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island is one of Abu Dhabi's leading leisure and lifestyle destinations, combining beaches, mangroves, golf and world-class entertainment. Yas Mall, Yas Marina, Yas Marina Circuit, SeaWorld Yas Island, Yas Waterworld, Ferrari World and Warner Bros. World sit within easy reach, alongside restaurants, hotels, golf courses, beaches and landscaped parks spread across the island, creating a lively yet relaxed setting for families and professionals.

Zayed International Airport is a short drive away, and Saadiyat Island, Louvre Abu Dhabi and the city centre are easily reached. Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Highway and Abu Dhabi–Dubai Highway connect residents with the capital and Dubai, while international schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the island and in neighbouring districts, making daily life convenient for residents of all ages.

Yas Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most popular residential destinations in Abu Dhabi. A strong leisure and tourism offer supports steady demand from families, professionals and tenants. Park-side residences with hotel-style services are in limited supply on the island, underpinning long-term value and attractive rental prospects, with a wide pool of tenants seeking quality family homes on the island.
